- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended hiking trails in Yellowstone include:
  1. Uncle Tom's Trail (view of Lower Falls)
  2. Mount Washburn (6.2 miles round trip, panoramic views)
  3. Fairy Falls Trail (5.4 miles round trip, leads to Fairy Falls)
  4. South Rim Trail (2.5 miles round trip, views of Grand Canyon)
  5. Mystic Falls Trail (2.5 miles round trip, leads to Mystic Falls)
